name: ghostkeys
title: Ghostkeys
description: Check sensor status, pause/resume, search and edit gesture bindings, bind presets, watch live gestures, and apply zone layouts for Ghostkeys.
author: sohamaggarwal

commands.name: status
commands.title: Ghostkeys Status
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Shows sensors, paused/calibrated state, and recent gestures.

commands.name: toggle-pause
commands.title: Pause / Resume Ghostkeys
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Pauses Ghostkeys if it's running, or resumes it if it's paused.

commands.name: search-bindings
commands.title: Search Bindings
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Search gesture bindings; toggle enabled, dry-test, or copy as JSON.

commands.name: bind-preset
commands.title: Bind a Preset
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Pick a preset action, then a zone and gesture, and add it as a binding.

commands.name: watch-gestures
commands.title: Watch Gestures
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Live feed of taps, gestures, and rejected inputs as they happen.

commands.name: apply-layout
commands.title: Apply Layout
commands.subtitle: Ghostkeys
commands.description: Pick a zone layout preset, preview the diff against the current config, and apply it.
